name: Gran Meliá Fenix
positioning: Hotel Fénix Gran Meliá, a Leading Hotels of the World member on Calle de Hermosilla in central Madrid, near Paseo de la Castellana and Calle Serrano
best_for: Travelers who want a central Madrid base near the major art museums
Guests who want RedLevel suites with private terraces over Plaza de Colón

facts.text: The hotel is at Calle de Hermosilla 2 in Madrid, next to Paseo de la Castellana and Calle Serrano.
The hotel sits in the heart of Madrid's financial and commercial center.
The hotel is near El Prado, the National Archaeological Museum, the Reina Sofía and the Thyssen-Bornemisza.
The hotel is part of The Leading Hotels of the World.
Zuma serves Japanese cuisine with three experiences: contemporary dishes, a robata grill and a sushi bar.
Zuma has a terrace open all year round, heated in winter.
Aduana serves Mediterranean fusion cuisine built around global spices.
Balmoral is the hotel's bar, serving cocktails, traditional tapas and Mediterranean cuisine.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment.
RedLevel guests have a private lounge, private reception and private breakfast service.
The hotel offers a private tour of Las Ventas bullring with a bullfighting expert, including the Bullfighting Museum.
Guests can tour the Seseña cape workshop with the founder's great-grandson.

highlights.text: Aduana is the hotel's seventh-floor restaurant, with views over Plaza de Colón and the Salamanca district.
The Thai room wellness space is decorated with Burmese decor, Chinese ornaments and Tibetan artwork.
Several RedLevel suites have private terraces with hot tubs overlooking Plaza de Colón.
A complimentary Luxury Van takes guests around the city of Madrid.
The hotel's dog program allows up to two dogs per room with no weight limit.

considerations.text: The hotel is 13 km from the airport.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with city noise.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
